```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
#loading packages
library('dplyr')
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(jtools)
library('interactions')
library(ltm)
library(car)
library(MBESS)

#loading data
post <- read.csv("~/Post-test Data.csv")
```

#Demographic
```{r}
#Gender, age and click cound data distribution
post$gender <- factor(post$gender)
levels(post$gender) <- c('female', 'non-binary', 'male')
post  %>% count(gender)
post  %>% count(alumni)
describe(post[, c("age", "graduation")], range=TRUE) #Clicks for skewness and kurtosis
```

# Thought counts
##Total thought
```{r}
#Thought about self-interest benefits at least once
m1 = glm(Total_self ~ IS, data=post, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
library(aod)
l <- matrix(c(0, 1), nrow = 1) # Specifies the contrast to test, e.g., testing if IS coefficient is equal to 0
Anova(m1, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR

#Thought about other-regarding benefits at least once
m1 = glm(Total_other ~ IS, data=post, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
```
```{r}
#Thought about self-interest benefits at least once
Means.Table<-post %>%
  group_by(IS) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(Total_self),
            SD=sd(Total_self),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)

#Thought about other-regarding benefits at least once
Means.Table<-post %>%
  group_by(IS) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(Total_other),
            SD=sd(Total_other),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)
```
##First thought
```{r}
#First thought was on self-interest benefits
m1 = glm(First_Self ~ IS, data=post, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
library(aod)
l <- matrix(c(0, 1), nrow = 1) # Specifies the contrast to test, e.g., testing if IS coefficient is equal to 0
Anova(m1, type="III", test="Wald")
exp(cbind(OR = coef(m1), confint(m1))) #OR

#First thought was on other-regarding benefits
m1 = glm(First_other ~ IS, data=post, family = "binomial"(link='logit'))
summ(m1, digit=4)
```
```{r}
#First thought was on self-interest benefits
Means.Table<-post %>%
  group_by(IS) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(First_Self),
            SD=sd(First_Self),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)

#First thought was on other-regarding benefits
Means.Table<-post %>%
  group_by(IS) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(First_other),
            SD=sd(First_other),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)
```
# Measured variables
```{r}
post  %>% count(IS)
```

```{r}
post$relcons <- post$Focus_self/(post$Focus_self+post$Focus_others)

#Relative attention
t.test(relcons ~ IS, data=post, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(post$relcons, post$IS,sd) #SD
ci.smd(ncp= 3.5769, n.1=94, n.2=89, conf.level=.95)

#Focus on helping
t.test(Focus_others ~ IS, data=post, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(post$Focus_others, post$IS,sd) #SD

#Focus on self
t.test(Focus_self ~ IS, data=post, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(post$Focus_self, post$IS,sd) #SD
ci.smd(ncp= 3.1897, n.1=94, n.2=89, conf.level=.95)

#Guilt
t.test(guilt ~ IS, data=post, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(post$guilt, post$IS,sd) #SD
ci.smd(ncp= 2.03, n.1=94, n.2=89, conf.level=.95)

#Reciprocity
t.test(reciprocity ~ IS, data=post, var.equal=TRUE)
tapply(post$reciprocity, post$IS,sd) #SD
```
